title: Basic
description: Typing filters the options by label, ignoring case and accents, and marks the matches. An option can carry a description.

title: Tags: multiple with create
description: multiple shows the chosen values as removable chips; allowCreate offers “Create …” for new text and fires create. Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip. This replaces the old Tags component.

title: Remote search
description: With remote, the app filters: typing fires search-change (Livewire entangles search-model after a debounce), and the combobox shows the options it's given. loading shows the spinner while results load.

title: Validation, sizes and clearing
description: The error is linked to the input. clearable adds a button that clears the value. Small, medium and large match Input.
